title: Window miniatures/previews and tooltips don't float to match the floating "Panel and Widgets"
line: Tooltips and window previews of panel widgets now float away from the panel with the same gap as their popups when widgets float.
explanation: When a panel prefers floating applets (floating panel, or the "Only widgets" floating mode), applet popups are given a margin so they float away from the panel, but ToolTipArea never set a margin on the shared tooltip window, so tooltips and task manager window previews stayed attached to the panel. ToolTipArea now checks whether any applet it belongs to (including system tray icons) is in a containment that prefers floating applets and, if so, gives the tooltip the same Kirigami largeSpacing margin popups use; otherwise the margin is reset to 0.

commits.message:
declarativeimports/core: float tooltips when the panel floats applets

Popups of applets in a panel that prefers floating applets keep a gap
from the panel, but tooltips stayed glued to it. Tooltips of such
applets now get the same margin as their popups.

BUG: 526985

media.caption: Floating panel: the Konsole window preview touches the panel
The window preview now floats with the same gap as popups
Digital clock tooltip glued to the floating panel
Digital clock tooltip floating above the panel

review.text: Fixes the issue cleanly in libplasma's ToolTipArea by walking ancestor items for ContainmentPrefersFloatingApplets (covering both regular panel widgets and nested System Tray icons, even when ToolTipArea.location is explicitly set) and applying Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing as the tooltip dialog margin. Resetting margin to 0 on non-floating panels avoids leaking state on the shared ToolTipDialog, and the existing 200 ms dismiss delay keeps interactive task previews usable across the 8 px gap. Screenshots, regression checks, and tooltip autotests verify the fix well.
